Four-second builder deadline, 3.5-second child deadline, 2 MiB RPC response cap, 256 KiB child input/64 KiB output. Review modules lazy loaded on Continue: 30,302 bytes (review, wallet-review, state and CSS). Real Rust/SVM cross-language mint/resale/burn/restart case 474.078 ms in a local fixture on new Mac; this is not mainnet latency.

acceptance: A fresh installation can complete the Lyssajudron and reach the mint inside Harmony.
Failed, cancelled or incomplete Lyssajudron work cannot authorize a mint.
Cancelling wallet approval leaves the completed Lyssajudron available for retry.
Restart or lost confirmation does not charge or issue again for an already completed mint.
Harmony only displays minted after the expected NFT owner and asset are verified on mainnet.
Private traces, room recordings and local source content are not published by the mint.
